data.title: Focus
data.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input
data.description: Focus identifies the interactive element currently controlled by the keyboard or another input method. A visible focus indicator is essential for navigation and form entry. It may differ from hover, but it should be at least as easy to see.

use: Any interactive element that can receive input
avoid: Remove the browser outline without a replacement
Show focus only after a mouse click if keyboard users need it
Use an indicator with too little contrast
Move focus somewhere unexpected after an action

lessonPractice.title: A keyboard user cannot tell which control Tab will operate. What should be added first?

options.label: Keep a clear visible focus style on interactive controls
options.feedback: Correct. Focus indication tells keyboard users their position and cannot be replaced by hover.

options.label: Remove the browser focus outline for a cleaner UI
options.feedback: Invisible focus removes position from keyboard operation and hides what Enter will trigger.

options.label: Improve hover only because keyboard users also see a mouse
options.feedback: Keyboard operation does not depend on pointer position; hover cannot replace focus.

data.agentPrompt: Add consistent high-contrast focus-visible styles for links, buttons, and inputs without removing default focus. Enter the page from the address bar using only keyboard and Tab through it; every position must be visible and Enter must trigger the expected control.
